Though people had treated their showdown 
as a mere spectacle, the sheer intensity 
of the race caught everyone off guard, 
leaving much of the audience utterly 
stunned.

Although Hishi Akebono missed out on first 
place, she felt she gave it everything she 
had. Her body was in top condition.

Promising to eventually run in the "Mile 
Championship", her next target race is set 
to the "Swan Stakes"!

Meanwhile... Biko Pegasus looked visibly 
downcast, while Taiki Shuttle was in the 
stands, bursting with excitement over the 
race.

Amid a swirl of mixed emotions, the race 
came to a close... and the days leading up 
to the next Swan Stakes began.
